review_notes: I read the whole file, lines 1–152. It has no definitions, structures, or functions. It contains only numerical and ideal-theoretic facts about a fifth cyclotomic field. These are the degree, discriminant, signature, label, monogenicity, class number, unit rank, torsion order, and the ramification data of 5 (ideal equality, ramification index, inertia degree, and the factorization 5𝓞K = 𝔭⁴). Each fact is a scalar or an ideal equality, so none of them is a map or action whose homomorphism, continuity, equivalence or action structure could be bundled. The `variable` declarations only fix hypotheses. I did not search the sources, because there is no construction in the file to match against a standard bundle. The rubric therefore has no suitable target, and I see no practical improvement to propose. The one residual uncertainty is that I did not check whether other files in the library contain related constructions.
